scriptOverride.reason: Reaction trigger inspects three fields on the conflict event itself (event.conflict.elements, event.conflict.winner, event.conflict.defendingPlayer) to check the card holder both won and defended a conflict declared with a matching element. card-schema.json's predicate vocabulary covers card/player-level checks (isType, hasStatus, compareValues, ...) but deliberately doesn't try to generalize arbitrary per-event-type field access - event shapes differ too much between event names to model generically without effectively embedding a query language.
